escena: SCENE (Efeonce studio, Santiago, late afternoon): the brand library corridor of the Efeonce office, from a chair at a small white table at its entrance, looking straight down a corridor 8 m long in exact one-point perspective with the vanishing point at the centre of the frame, seen from the chair of someone sitting there on a video call — camera at SEATED EYE LEVEL (about 1.15 m), 28 mm lens at f/5.6, like a good webcam view; horizon level, verticals straight. BOTH SIDES: floor-to-ceiling walls of backlit archive cabinets in a perfect grid, each cell a small glowing panel holding a brand piece from Image 3 (the line colour swatches, type specimens, orbits, icons, the isotype and the words «Hacer.» and «Crear.»), repeated along both walls and receding symmetrically towards the far end; their cool light reflects as long streaks on the polished microcement floor, and a light clean haze turns the glow into a soft volumetric bloom. CENTRE: the far end of the corridor is a calm matte dark-navy wall in soft shade, with nothing on it, behind where the person sits. LEFT THIRD: on the nearest panel of the left wall, high, Image 2 exactly — the small question with its orange ring and the huge answer «Intacta» with its orange sphere — as crisp matte white and orange vinyl on a dark-navy panel. At the bottom RIGHT, on the small white table, the official Efeonce logo from Image 1 as a small solid DEEP NAVY (#023C70, dark ink blue, never royal blue) desk object about 24 cm wide and 6 cm tall, standing upright between 74% and 94% of the frame width, turned towards the camera: product placement, reproduced exactly (every letter of «efeonce», the ship emblem with its orbit ring, its cuts and its three small windows), satin finish, crisp bevel. TRACES OF WORK: one archive drawer left half open on the right wall, a pair of white cotton archive gloves on the table. MODERN STUDIO (2026, premium technology company): smooth exposed concrete ceiling with recessed black linear LED profiles switched off; seamless microcement floor; furniture with clean lines on slim black steel legs; current-generation technology only. Nothing vintage or rustic, no clutter. TEXT EXCEPTION: the logo from Image 1 and the artworks from Image 2 and Image 3 are the ONLY readable marks in the picture; they stay crisp and legible, every letter and word exactly as in the references, never blurred, altered or translated; every other screen or label stays illegible by physical means.
